t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The other participant made choices based on the height of the gnomes. The taller of the gnomes yielded better results for them.

vb_textbox.text: My best yields were based on the color of the basket in the forest. There are only two and the basket a gnome will go to will remain consistent. i.e. Blue Tall gnome will always go to a yellow basket. The yields of the basket will change as the game goes on, so if you feel that the color of basket is giving less switch to the other basket. Be on your toes and alert at your yields to maximize value back.
